name: A Trick and a Treat: Dead Letters (and one other)
source:
[i]A Trick and a Treat[/i] is a kinetic visual novel composed of two short stories made for the Halloween season!

In [i]Dead Letters[/i], a man working at a post office opens a letter not meant for his eyes, and learns something he shouldn't.

In [i]Vamp Me![/i], Jen arrives home after a Halloween party, only to be met with an unexpected sight.

[From [url=https://air-gong.itch.io/a-trick-and-a-treat]itch.io[/url]]
